prompt: Propose a sequencing assay that jointly measures newly synthesized RNA and cell-surface protein identity in individual cells, with existing sequencing equipment. Investigate whether this capability is already demonstrated. If it is, identify a specific useful improvement over the closest implementation rather than presenting the combination itself as new. Return a proposed assay architecture as a State–Operation–Flow graph, the proposed change, its experimental precedents, unresolved interfaces and a discriminating experiment.
preferences: Prefer accessible reagents and laboratory equipment
Preserve multiple mechanistically distinct ideas if justified
